description: Moves a tender of the signed-in company's 'Moje przetargi' (tender_id) to another status, with the moves the app allows: between the company's own kanban stages (e.g. Do_przejrzenia), to Do_wysłania or Oczekiwanie_na_wynik, closing it as Wygrana, Uczciwa_przegrana, Nieuczciwa_przegrana, Anulowane, Do_odwołania or Odpuszczam, back from Do_wysłania / Oczekiwanie_na_wynik to a work stage, and an appeal to Udane_odwołanie or Nieudane_odwołanie. Odpuszczam needs a reason; for a loss, cancellation or appeal the reason is optional, for Wygrana the contract value. A refused move lists the allowed statuses. Saved to the status history; the rest of the team is notified as in the app. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

reason.description: why — required for Odpuszczam; for losses, cancellation and appeals optional

status.description: target status: a kanban column id of the company or a system status

winning_price.description: contract value in PLN, for Wygrana

name: set_tender_status
